newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya bans sale of local anti-AIDS treatment.
newsitem.headline: Kenya bans sale of local anti-AIDS treatment.

text.p: The Kenya government's drugs inspectorate has banned the sale of a herbal preparation marketed in Nairobi for the treatment of AIDS, the Sunday Nation reported.

The newspaper said the chief drugs inspector on Saturday ordered Professor Arthur Obel to stop selling the preparation, marketed under the name of Pearl Omega, which Obel had been producing since 1994.
Obel told reporters on Sunday thousands of AIDS victims had benefited from using the preparation in the past. He expressed shock at the banning order.
Up to a million Kenyans are already carrying the HIV virus which causes Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome, medical sources said.
